subject: Exec pod rightsizing + protected handoffs
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exec pod rightsizing + protected handoffs

Morning —

I've attached a short proposal for a compacting of two executive-facing pods into a single 'platform + customer' pod that reduces duplicate operational effort across compute infra and customer handoffs. High-level goals: reduce cross-pod on-call and redundant SLAs, centralize shared infra responsibilities, and create a small protected band for sensitive customer handoffs (HIPAA/PHI and regulated customers).

What I'm proposing (summary):
- Combine "Edge Serving" and "Customer Integrations" pods into a single 12-headcount pod under a single lead.
- Move day-to-day kernel & runtime ownership to Platform Services (matrix dotted-line to new pod).
- Create a 3-person "Protected Handoff" lane that owns onboarding and sensitive-customer operational runbooks; only designated engineers + CS may join.
- Freeze new outward hiring for 60 days to prioritize internal redeployment.

Impacted roles: see attached affected_headcount.xlsx. Rough numbers: 4 direct ICs will be moved to Platform Services, 3 into the Protected Handoff lane, and 5 candidates will be offered redeployment or voluntary exits depending on preference.

Timeline I'm proposing:
- Jan 12: Leadership sign-off on scope + affected list (confidential).
- Jan 13–20: HR 1:1s for impacted folks (Monica to lead).
- Jan 21: Group comms and migration plan published (internal only).
- Feb 1: New pod structure live.

Risks I'm flagging:
- Losing senior ICs who prefer product-facing work over platform tasks.
- Short-term support gaps for specific enterprise customers during cutover.
- Need for legal/finance sign-off on any severance or pay adjustments.

Deliverables attached: rightsizing_summary.pdf, affected_headcount.xlsx.

Please reply with: (a) any blockers you need considered, (b) edits to timeline, (c) list of any internal-only approvers I should add.

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec pod rightsizing + protected handoffs

Rohan —

Thanks for the clear write-up. A few immediate questions / asks before sign-off:

1) Can you share anonymized review & attrition metrics for the affected set? I want to understand if these are performance-based moves or structural.
2) What's the plan for critical-path enterprise customers (esp Goldcrest) — we can't have a week of degraded SLAs. If the protected lane is 3 people, how does on-call scale?
3) Recommend we involve Legal and Finance before Jan 12 for any severance language or comp adjustments.

Also: curious about the 60-day hiring freeze. Are we confident we won't need quick backfills for platform expertise? If not, suggest a carve-out approval process for mission-critical roles.

Quote below for context:
> Impacted roles: see attached affected_headcount.xlsx. Rough numbers: 4 direct ICs will be moved to Platform Services, 3 into the Protected Handoff lane, and 5 candidates will be offered redeployment or voluntary exits depending on preference.

cc: add Legal and Finance if we get alignment.

—Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Serving Runtime

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec pod rightsizing + protected handoffs

Thanks Rohan — this is the right direction but we need a tighter comms approach. My asks:

- Monica, please hold the first wave of 1:1s as private and prioritize re-deployment conversations before any mention of severance. We want to maximize internal moves.
- Rohan/Markus: provide a 1-page talking guide for managers that includes: (a) reason for change, (b) reassurance for career growth, (c) FAQs for customers.
- Do NOT notify external partners (Tara/CloudMarket) about structure changes until we confirm handoff owners.

We should also run a quick 'flight risk' check on the senior ICs — if someone has expressed interest in product roles externally we should give them first-class options. Markus — can your team provide the anonymized metrics you mentioned?

Laura
Laura Bennett
GM, Platform Partnerships

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec pod rightsizing + protected handoffs

Folks —

I've reviewed the attachments and sketched a confidential HR playbook for the Jan 13–20 1:1 window. Key points:

- My approach will be redeployment-first. We'll present three options to impacted employees: (1) redeploy to Platform Services with a 3-month on-ramp + training stipend; (2) redeploy into the Protected Handoff lane (if eligible); (3) voluntary exit with a standard severance package (TBD with Finance).
- I'll run 30-minute 1:1s and use the attached HR-communication-templates.docx. All notes will be stored in a secure HR folder; only People Ops + the relevant manager will have access.
- For regulated customers (HIPAA/PHI), we will schedule dedicated handoff calls with the customer's security contact and include a compliance checklist. Monica from Goldcrest People Ops is listed as an external contact — we won't copy outside until handoff owners are confirmed.

A few asks for leadership:
- Please confirm Finance & Legal reviewers to loop in by EOD Jan 11.
- Approval to offer training stipends up to $6k per IC for redeployment.
- Permission to run a short pulse survey post-comm to catch early flight risk signals.

I'll proceed with confidential scheduling once I have a thumbs-up on the above.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of People Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachment: HR-communication-templates.docx

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec pod rightsizing + protected handoffs

All —

Thanks. Good points from everyone. Quick confirmations:

- I'll share anonymized perf/attrition metrics with Markus by EOD Jan 9.
- Laura: I will draft the 1-page manager talking guide and circulate by Jan 11 for edits.
- Monica: you have approval to run the 1:1 schedule Jan 13–20 and to offer up to $6k training stipends; I'll start the finance approval loop today.
- We will pause any external comms to Tara/CloudMarket until handoff owners are confirmed.

Next steps:
1) Rohan -> Markus: anonymized metrics (due Jan 9)
2) Rohan -> Laura: manager guide v0 (due Jan 11)
3) Monica -> schedule and confidential 1:1s (Jan 13–20)
4) Leadership: confirm Legal + Finance reviewers (by EOD Jan 11)

If there are no blockers by EOD Jan 12 I will consider this scope signed and instruct the org systems team to prepare the role moves.

Thanks,
Rohan
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
